description: Right-to-left layout and a configurable Persian font for the Cursor AI chat.
config.enabled: Apply RTL layout to the Cursor chat. Turning this off removes the patch from Cursor's files.
config.direction.auto: Detect per paragraph: Persian paragraphs RTL, English paragraphs LTR.
config.font.family:
Font family used for chat text (must be installed on your system). Leave empty to keep Cursor's default font.

[Pick from installed fonts](command:cursorRtl.selectFont)
config.font.size: Chat font size in pixels. `0` keeps Cursor's default.
config.font.lineHeight: Chat line height (e.g. `1.8`). `0` keeps Cursor's default.
config.font.applyToInput: Also use the font in the chat input box.
config.customCss: Extra CSS appended after the built-in rules.
